description: Parameters of the normalization stage. Applies only to the min_max normalization technique.

lower_bounds.description: Optional. The lower bound of each hybrid query clause, positional against hybrid.queries. When set, must hold exactly 5 entries — the maximum hybrid.queries length. When a query has fewer than 5 clauses, only the bounds of the clauses it provides are used. If not provided, no lower bound is applied and each clause's actual minimum score is used for normalization.

upper_bounds.description: Optional. The upper bound of each hybrid query clause, positional against hybrid.queries. When set, must hold exactly 5 entries — the maximum hybrid.queries length. When a query has fewer than 5 clauses, only the bounds of the clauses it provides are used. If not provided, no upper bound is applied and each clause's actual maximum score is used for normalization.
